description: Renovate only maintains the go directive in go.mod; Dependabot handles Go modules and GitHub Actions.

packageRules.description: Module dependencies are left to Dependabot.

Keep the go directive on the oldest supported Go release (N-1) at x.y.0. Go ships a minor every ~6 months and supports the latest two, so a release becomes N-1 roughly when it is 6 months old; 200 days lets the next release land first.
